_comment_id: Unique identifier for your extension (lowercase, hyphens). Must match the folder name.
_comment_name: Display name shown in the Marketplace and extension manager.
name: {{APP_NAME}}
_comment_version: Semantic version (major.minor.patch). Bump patch on updates.
_comment_description: Short description (1-2 sentences) shown in the Marketplace listing.
_comment_author: Your name or organization. Shown in extension details.
author: {{CREATOR}}
_comment_category: Category for filtering. Options: editor, tools, language, theme, ui-theme, productivity, debug.
_comment_icon: Lucide icon name (e.g. puzzle, palette, layout, zap, code, settings).
_comment_color: CSS gradient or color for the extension card in the Marketplace.
_comment_type: Optional. Set to 'ui-theme' for full UI theme extensions (changes entire interface look).
_comment_colors: Optional. Preview color palette for theme extensions. Example: { 'background': '#1e1e2e', 'foreground': '#cdd6f4', 'accent': '#89b4fa' }
_comment_files: Optional array of extra files to include when publishing. Example: ['styles/custom.css', 'data/config.json']
